title: Cross-Platform Application Migration to HarmonyOS: An Agentic Pipeline with Artifact-Derived Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.33197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The migration of applications written for a different platforms like Android or iOS to HarmonyOS NEXT requires a complete rewrite in ArkTS. Although LLMs automate the translation of source constructs into ArkTS, syntactic compilation is not enough and functional assurance is a critical open challenge in HarmonyOS NEXT migration. We present HMOS~Migrator, an agentic pipeline that reads an application's source code, generates an ArkTS project, and validates the result by replaying recorded interactions on a real device. We cast the scoring problem as quality estimation without a reference implementation; we score a migration using only the source application's recorded behaviour and the artifacts produced by the pipeline. We define seven weighted metrics, each constructed so that reduced measurement cannot artificially raise the score. tldr: 该论文提出了HMOS Migrator，一个智能体流水线，能自动将Android/iOS应用源码转换为ArkTS项目，并通过在真实设备上重放录制交互，以及仅基于源应用行为和流水线产物的七个加权指标进行无参考实现的质量评估，从而验证迁移后的功能正确性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents HMOS Migrator, an agentic pipeline that automatically converts Android/iOS applications into ArkTS projects and validates functional correctness by replaying recorded interactions on real devices and scoring migrations with seven weighted metrics derived solely from the source app's recorded behavior and pipeline artifacts, without requiring a reference implementation.
